column1: # compat: `drop-in` = the replacement takes the same arguments and returns the same values in the same order (extra trailing
# returns allowed), checked against warcraft.wiki.gg and Blizzard's API documentation: the macro report offers a fixed text for it.
# `first:<field>:<min>-<max>` = the old function returned several values and the replacement returns a table whose <field> is the
# old first value; fixed only where just that value is used and the call has min..max arguments (nil table: `(f(x) or {}).field`).
# `one-arg` = a drop-in only for a call with one argument (the old function also took `(slot, bookType)`).
# Both are marked "check in game". Empty = not provably the same call: a hint only.
# Bare global functions removed from the Retail client. Matched as whole words in /run and /script lines,
